quand: Sent by the Made to measure role the day after a request still waiting for an answer: the client knows it arrived and can book a video call.

rendezvous.description: The link to book a video call with the designer

blocs.texte:
Hello {prenom},

Your made-to-measure request has reached the atelier. The designer is reading it carefully and will answer you personally.
If you would rather talk it through, you can already book a video call with her: {rendezvous}

See you very soon,
The Awrea Paris atelier
